contrary_evidence: Six of seven flash composite PMIs are above 50; the evidence indicates dispersion, not synchronized global contraction.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rebounded on 23 November, and AP attributes a concentrated part of the move to Nvidia's 31.5% rise after the board reinstated Jensen Huang.
IEA October supply and observed inventories increased, supporting a crude rebalancing interpretation even while refined-product constraints remained.
Brent settled lower on 23 November while European diesel remained materially above pre-war levels; crude and product markets should not be conflated.
Brazil's central-government primary deficit improved year over year through September and real revenue grew faster than expenditure, tempering a one-sided fiscal deterioration thesis.
limitations: No complete comparable daily FX-flow panel for smaller markets was verified.
The ICE BofA OAS series covers US dollar-denominated below-investment-grade corporate bonds, not global credit costs or all private-credit pricing.
IIF's US$33.8bn estimate is a monthly non-resident portfolio-flow measure, not total capital flight or FDI.
The Worldsteel October crude-steel release schedule is not separately sourced; the report should remove the expectation language or cite the official release calendar.
The system-registry reconciliation has not been run and remains a publication prerequisite.
